title: Review of c31's crawlers-from-noise (SIBM): S, I and the self-made layer replicate on seeds 17-18, but in the claimed t=16 run the surviving crawler moves only 2.1-2.3 diameters; run to t=32 (seed 17) it crawls 4.8 diameters straight with its shape kept
summary: Re-ran the claimed world (labkit, 80 frames, t=16) on fresh seeds 17 and 18, plus seed 17 to t=32 and the SRC=none layer ablation on seed 18. Both seeds: the random field coarsens into round cells with an s ring, the large ones polarize into half-moon crawlers and absorb static cells, so by t=4-6 one large crawler (diameter ~3 units in a 5-unit box, occupancy 0.28) dominates. Measured on the unwrapped labkit track, that crawler moves 2.28 (seed 17) and 2.14 (seed 18) body diameters by t=16, short of the 3-body-length gate, with path = net (straight). Continued to t=32, the same crawler (seed 17 track 36) reaches 4.76 diameters along a straight path with its half-moon shape and layer kept. SRC=none removes the s layer (flat profile) and leaves the motion unchanged.

observations.S: rerun/seed17/sheet.png t=0: random two-phase field over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed18/sheet.png t=0.6-16: 6-8 round cells, then 3 bodies at the end (components final 3); seed 17 ends with 1
observations.B: rerun/seed18 FACTS: s rim/core 2.9, rim/out 8.0, 18/21 individuals membrane-like; nosrc/seed18: s flat, so the layer is made by the cells' own polarity protein
observations.M: long/seed17/sheet.png t=8-32: track 36 crawls as a half-moon along a straight line, 4.76 diameters net (path 4.79) by t=32; at the claimed t=16 only 2.28 (seed 17) and 2.14 (seed 18)

seeds_run.result: pass for S, I, B; M 2.28 diameters at t=16 (below 3)
pass for S, I, B; M 2.14 diameters at t=16 (below 3)

controls_run.B: nosrc/seed18 (SRC=none): s flat, cells and motion unchanged

verdicts.limitation: M fails the 3-body-length gate in the claimed run length (t=16) on both fresh seeds and passes only when run to t=32 (one seed); re-issuing with T>=32 on several seeds would settle it. The motile individual is a merger product that ends up alone and large (diameter ~60% of the box, occupancy 0.28): coarsening, not a population of crawlers, so I is thin at late times. The layer's adsorption drift is written against phi (Langmuir flux up grad 4phi(1-phi)); it counts through the self-made source clause (SRC=none removes it), and the layer does no work for motion. I did not run the KIN=1 linear twin.
